answer.reason: All 3 attempts failed on a real, reproducible defect: DefiLlamaStablecoinSupplyOk/SosoValueEtfFlowOk/BackfilledAlternativeMeFearGreedOk had no endpoint field, so persist_board's fallback silently misattributed every backfilled row's provenance to the live snapshot URL across three vendors. Fixing that then surfaced a second, more serious defect: DefiLlamaStablecoinChartEntry's extra="forbid" rejected every real /stablecoincharts response (undeclared vendor fields), making the entire DefiLlama backfill recipe 100% non-functional against live data despite all offline tests passing. Both fixed and verified live. The three machine-checkable criteria (C1-C3) now pass; C4 is the story's own [human] criterion and opens its own G6_HUMAN gate instead. See verdict.json overrideReason.
